results.name: widget_list_navigate_selection
results.evidence: Increments/decrements a short at param+0x40 with wraparound via max at param+0x48 based on the direction result from FUN_004a1ff0, then calls list-refresh helper FUN_00498e90.
results.summary: Handles left/right navigation input for a cyclable list widget, adjusting its selected index with wraparound and triggering a refresh.

results.name: settings_list_widget_populate_byte_values
results.evidence: Walks three sibling list-widgets (type==2) and writes clamped 0-10 byte values from unaff_ESI+0x954/+0x955 and a boolean from +0x12f into their value field (+0x40).
results.summary: Populates three list-widget display values from byte fields in an unidentified settings/profile structure.

results.name: settings_list_widget_build
results.evidence: Thin wrapper: calls FUN_004a20f0 (value populate) then FUN_00498e90 (list refresh) and returns 1, the standard on-build callback pattern.
results.summary: List-widget build/refresh callback that populates values then refreshes the widget.

results.name: controller_settings_list_widget_populate
results.evidence: Walks six sibling list-widgets, writing clamped 0-10 values from unaff_EDI+0xb78..0xb7f and gating one field's enabled alpha (+0x24=0x3eaa7efa/0x3f800000) on DAT_007252e0/DAT_00746120.
results.summary: Populates a row of settings list-widgets (sensitivity-like 0-10 values and enable flags) from a controller/profile byte block.

results.name: audio_options_apply_from_profile
results.evidence: Reads three list-widget values (0-10, offsets matching FUN_004a22e0's 0xb78/0xb79/0xb7a) and calls FUN_00548590, sound_set_effects_gain, FUN_00548680 with value*0.1 clamped 0..1 only when the value changed.
results.summary: Compares displayed volume slider values against the stored profile and applies changed values to the sound engine gain controls.

results.name: profile_selection_widget_reset
results.evidence: Calls FUN_0053c4e0(0,&local,0) then FUN_00495be0 (used elsewhere alongside player_profile_save) and returns 1.
results.summary: Small helper that resets/initializes something via FUN_0053c4e0 and FUN_00495be0, likely tied to the player-profile subsystem.

results.name: network_profile_defaults_widget_init
results.evidence: Copies the ~0x2000-byte global profile blob at DAT_00712dd8 to the stack, sets default name/team fields via FUN_00625b7a+_wcscpy into DAT_00719170/DAT_007191f0, and picks values from a 5-entry lookup table (DAT_0065bfb4/DAT_0065bf74).
results.summary: Initializes default profile name fields and a resolution/quality-like list selection, enabling widgets based on network-capability globals.

results.name: network_host_setup_widget_refresh
results.evidence: Uses inet_ntoa on DAT_006869b4 (byte-swapped local IP) to build an address string widget, copies DAT_00719170/DAT_007191f0 name fields via heap_reallocate+_wcsncpy, records which sibling widget has input focus, and finishes with set_profile_name.
results.summary: Refreshes the network game host setup widgets (player/team name, list selections, local IP address) and commits changes via set_profile_name.

results.name: restart_map_dialog_choice_handler
results.evidence: Compares the activated widget to the first two children of its parent's list; on the first choice, checks DAT_0087aa10 (game-over-like flag) and either restarts the map (FUN_00468260/004682c0/00466cb0) or prints "Cannot restart the map when the game is over." via chimera__console_out.
results.summary: Handles the two-choice restart-map confirmation dialog, restarting the current map unless the game has already ended.

results.name: controller_button_bindings_widget_populate
results.evidence: Unpacks a 32-bit value (from FUN_00465380) into six 3-bit fields (shifts 4,7,10,0xd,0x10,0x13) and writes each (clamped <5) into successive sibling list-widgets, toggling an enable flag/alpha per field.
results.summary: Decodes a packed bitfield (likely controller action bindings) into six list-widget values with per-field enable state.

results.name: network_game_options_widget_populate
results.evidence: When unaff_ESI!=0, writes a clamped 0-4 value from unaff_ESI+0xfc0 into a list-widget and copies two words from +0x1002/+0x1004 into DAT_00719210/DAT_00719214.
results.summary: Populates a network game-options list-widget value and two related global settings from a session/options structure.

results.name: network_game_options_widget_build
results.evidence: Wrapper calling FUN_0053a150, FUN_00498e90 (list refresh) and FUN_004a3960 (value populate), matching the standard build-callback pattern seen at FUN_004a2270.
results.summary: Build/refresh callback for the network game-options list widget.

results.name: hud_text_message_queue_init
results.evidence: Resets the growable message-array cap/count/pointer (DAT_006b37e8=0x14, DAT_006b37ec=0, DAT_006b37f0=0) and stores a QueryPerformanceCounter-derived millisecond timestamp base into DAT_0071922c, the same globals used by FUN_004a3d90/FUN_004a3e30.
results.summary: Initializes the on-screen text-message queue (capacity, count, base timestamp) used by the HUD message system.

results.name: hud_text_message_queue_add
results.evidence: Adds an entry to the growable_array (DAT_006b37f0) sized by growable_array_add_element, parsing \s<n> as a sound-cue reference (DAT_00660c34 tag) and \h as another marker, else storing the raw pointer with a default width.
results.summary: Appends a HUD text/chat message to the message queue, recognizing embedded \s (sound) and \h escape markers.

results.name: hud_text_message_queue_update_and_draw
results.evidence: Ages existing entries by elapsed time, removes ones with growable_array_remove_element once their timer drops below 0x32, refills from a source widget list via FUN_004a3d90, then renders remaining entries with chimera__draw_16_bit_text using per-flag color pointers.
results.summary: Updates message timers/removes expired entries, pulls in new messages, and draws the remaining HUD text message queue.

results.name: network_adapter_details_widget_refresh
results.evidence: Looks up the selected entry's data blob from the (&DAT_006b3834)[DAT_00692c04*3]/(&DAT_006b3838)[...] slot arrays (same arrays populated by FUN_004a7ba0's GlobalAlloc'd network-adapter records) and copies a type dword and name string from it, or disables the widgets if none found.
results.summary: Refreshes detail widgets (type flag and name) for the currently selected network adapter list entry.

results.name: sibling_widget_index_jump_dispatch
results.evidence: Computes param_1's position in its parent's child chain and performs an indirect call through jump table PTR_LAB_004a4850 indexed by that position minus one.
results.summary: Dispatches to one of several handler routines via a jump table based on which sibling widget was activated.

results.name: autopatch_status_widget_update
results.evidence: Polls autopatch_check_for_update_start() and switches on the result to set a widget flag (+0x40), enable/alpha (+0x12/+0x24) and poll-timer fields (+0x18/+0x1c/+0x20 = 300/500/0x2ee ms), calling FUN_00449210 to (re)arm the timer.
results.summary: Drives the 'checking for update' UI state machine widget by polling the autopatch subsystem and updating its display/timer.

results.name: network_name_fields_reset
results.evidence: Copies the global profile blob (DAT_00712dd8, same pattern as FUN_004a2ad0) to the stack, then blanks DAT_00719238, DAT_00719276 and DAT_007191f0.
results.summary: Resets the network name/team text-entry globals to blank, guarded by the current-profile check used elsewhere.

results.name: server_name_text_entry_commit
results.evidence: Validates input via FUN_004c8500, then on success copies DAT_00719238 into the profile block at offset 0xfc2 (adjacent to the 0xfc0 field populated by FUN_004a3960) and calls player_profile_save() if FUN_00495ea0 confirms, else invalidates the loaded profile (DAT_00714e7c=-1).
results.summary: Commits an edited text field (likely a server/game name) into the network options block and saves the player profile.

results.name: profile_name_fields_widget_refresh
results.evidence: Allocates and copies DAT_00719238 (0x1f wchars) and DAT_007191f0 (8 wchars) into two widgets' text buffers (+0x3c), records which one has focus, then commits via set_profile_name.
results.summary: Refreshes the name/team display widgets from the pending name-entry globals and commits the change.

results.name: tab_group_sync_selected_index_7way
results.evidence: Counts the position of the widget stored at param_1+0x38 within the sibling chain at param_1+0x34 (bounded 0..6) and writes it into a paired target widget's +0x40 and +0x2c->+0x58 fields.
results.summary: Synchronizes a 7-option tab/list group's selected index into a linked display widget.

results.name: tab_group_sync_selected_index_5way
results.evidence: Identical structure to FUN_004a4cb0 but bounded to 0..4 (5 options).
results.summary: Synchronizes a 5-option tab/list group's selected index into a linked display widget.

results.name: tab_group_sync_selected_index_special
results.evidence: Same sibling-position counting pattern as FUN_004a4cb0 but with a switch grouping indices {1,2,3},{5,6},{7} into distinct target values before writing, plus per-position enable flags.
results.summary: Synchronizes a tab/list group's selected index into a target widget using special-cased index groupings.

results.name: local_player_profile_assignment_widget_refresh
results.evidence: Sets three sibling widgets' +0x58 to 1/2/3 and, for local-player index in_EAX, reads a 4-byte-per-player entry from DAT_0071901c comparing against DAT_0071916a to decide sentinel or raw byte values.
results.summary: Refreshes the controller/profile-assignment display widgets for one local (split-screen) player slot.

results.name: local_player_profile_assignment_list_refresh
results.evidence: Calls set_profile_name, then FUN_004a7400 to obtain up to 3 indices and, for each, walks to the matching sibling widget and calls FUN_004a4e20.
results.summary: Iterates up to three local-player slots, refreshing each one's profile-assignment widget.

results.name: profile_slot_selector_widget_refresh
results.evidence: Writes param_1+0x3c into a paired display widget (+0x58/+0x40) if valid, commits via set_profile_name, then highlights (sets +0x58 bool) whichever of 4 sibling widgets matches the selected slot.
results.summary: Refreshes a 4-item profile/slot selector, highlighting the currently selected entry and syncing its paired display.

results.name: text_widget_copy_from_global_buffer
results.evidence: Lazily allocates a 0x80-byte buffer at param_1+0x3c via heap_reallocate then copies DAT_00719278 into it with _wcsncpy (0x3f chars).
results.summary: Ensures a widget's text buffer exists and refreshes it from a global text field.

results.name: server_list_menu_update
results.evidence: Matches the cea-pdb naming hint; scans up to 9 LAN/session slots (FUN_004da770) plus tracked internet games, matches map names against the ten stock multiplayer maps (beavercreek, sidewinder, damnation, ...), and builds the server-browser list widgets with "%s %s" name/map text.
results.summary: Rebuilds the multiplayer server-browser list, matching each discovered game's map/variant and populating the on-screen list widgets.

results.name: multiplayer_lobby_ready_flags_update
results.evidence: Iterates 16 slots off DAT_0071c2d8 calling FUN_004de9f0 twice per slot, comparing team ids and DAT_00719720 (post-game state seen elsewhere) before clearing a flag byte and conditionally calling FUN_004d9f50.
results.summary: Walks the network session's player slots clearing a per-player flag (likely 'ready'/'loaded') based on team and game-state checks.

results.name: multiplayer_settings_select_list_update_item
results.evidence: Already carries this non-FUN_ name; code matches: builds a description string for a game-variant/profile list item via tag_lookup("ui\\shell\\strings\\game_variant_descriptions") and formats per game-type switch case.
results.summary: Updates one multiplayer-settings selection list item, formatting its description from the game-variant tag data or profile-description labels.

results.name: multiplayer_settings_select_list_refresh_3wide
results.evidence: Uses FUN_004a7400 (3-wide index helper) and FUN_004a7570(3) (game-variant carousel slot assign) then calls multiplayer_settings_select_list_update_item for each of the 3 visible slots, finishing with set_profile_name.
results.summary: Refreshes the 3-wide visible window of the multiplayer game-variant selection list.

results.name: player_profile_details_widget_refresh
results.evidence: For a null profile pointer disables all detail widgets (+0x10=0) with a sentinel +0x58=0x12; otherwise enables them and copies the profile name (or a default from tag "ui\\shell\\strings\\default_player_profile_names"), sensitivity (clamped 0..0x11) and controller-type index.
results.summary: Refreshes the player-profile detail widgets (name, sensitivity, controller type, invert flag) for a selected profile, or blanks them if none is selected.

results.name: network_options_tab_group_sync_selected_index
results.evidence: Same sibling-index counting pattern as FUN_004a4cb0 (bounded 0..8) but additionally gates enable/alpha of index 0 on DAT_00718fc9 and index 2 on DAT_006b1844.
results.summary: Synchronizes a 9-option tab group's selected index, disabling specific options based on network-availability flags.

results.name: player_profile_1wide_list_update
results.evidence: Already carries this non-FUN_ name; code matches: builds the single visible profile-carousel entry, formats controller/button descriptions with "%s%hs%s" and sorts the 3-slot carousel cache via _qsort.
results.summary: Rebuilds the single-wide player-profile selection list item, including its formatted description text.

results.name: widget_group_enable_if_has_items
results.evidence: Walks the sibling chain accumulating a tag-driven item count (via DAT_0087bc14 tag-array lookup and a 'hidden' flag bit 0x150&4), then enables (+0x10=1) or disables the target widget based on whether any counted.
results.summary: Enables or disables a widget group depending on whether the associated list currently has any (non-hidden) items.

results.name: generic_select_list_widget_build
results.evidence: Calls the shared list-refresh helper FUN_004a7db0 with the default callback (&LAB_004a8310), commits via set_profile_name, then copies param_1+0x3c into a paired display widget's +0x40/+0x58.
results.summary: Generic build/refresh callback for a selection list widget that mirrors its selected value into a paired display widget.

results.name: network_adapter_config_3wide_refresh
results.evidence: Uses FUN_004a7400 (3-wide indices) and, for each of 3 visible slots, writes a value from the DAT_00712dcc array (same array used by FUN_004a8440/FUN_004a83d0 for per-adapter config) into the sibling widgets.
results.summary: Refreshes the 3-wide visible window of a per-network-adapter configuration list.

results.name: profile_list_get_name
results.evidence: Copies one ~0x2004-byte profile record (indexed by param_1+8 into the DAT_00712dd8 array, matching the array-of-profiles size seen elsewhere) to the stack and copies its embedded name into a widget's text buffer.
results.summary: Fetches and stores the name of the Nth stored player profile into a widget's text buffer.

results.name: profile_list_get_sensitivity
results.evidence: Same indexed profile-record copy as FUN_004a69f0, then reads a clamped 0..0x11 short field and writes it to param_1+0x58.
results.summary: Fetches a clamped sensitivity-like value from the Nth stored player profile into a widget field.

results.name: profile_widget_modified_flag_refresh
results.evidence: Walks up to the root parent widget, looks up its id in the single-entry DAT_00714dde table, then reads a flag byte from DAT_00712f07 offset by the profile-record stride (0x2004) to set the widget's +0x40 boolean.
results.summary: Sets a widget flag based on a per-profile status byte located via the root dialog's id.

results.name: list_widget_get_3wide_indices
results.evidence: Given a list cursor (in_ECX with current/max at +0x40/+0x48), computes and writes the previous/current/next item indices (wrapping via +0x48) into the caller's 3-element out array (in_EAX).
results.summary: Computes the selected item plus its previous/next neighbor indices for a 3-wide scrolling list widget.

results.name: profile_carousel_slot_assign
results.evidence: Matches incoming candidate ids against the 3 cached slots spaced 0x2000 bytes apart at DAT_00873d60 (the same array scanned in player_profile_1wide_list_update), filling any empty slot via FUN_0053a770.
results.summary: Assigns up to three profile pointers into the profile-carousel slot cache, validating each with FUN_0053a770.

results.name: game_variant_carousel_slot_assign
results.evidence: Same matching/filling algorithm as FUN_004a74b0 but over the 3 slots spaced 0x9c bytes apart at DAT_00879d60, validating with FUN_0053bee0.
results.summary: Assigns up to three game-variant entries into the variant-selection carousel slot cache.

results.name: profile_carousel_sort_valid_first
results.evidence: Classic qsort comparator treating -1 (empty) entries as greater than any valid entry, used by player_profile_1wide_list_update's _qsort call.
results.summary: qsort comparator that sorts valid (non -1) carousel entries before empty ones.

results.name: audio_options_slider_preview_apply
results.evidence: Reads three sibling widgets' 0-10 values directly (no profile comparison, unlike FUN_004a26a0), converts to 0..1 gain and calls FUN_00548590/sound_set_effects_gain/FUN_00548680, then updates an enable flag and calls FUN_004a66b0.
results.summary: Applies the current volume-slider widget values live to the sound engine and refreshes a related widget's enabled state.

results.name: network_adapter_list_free_all
results.evidence: Iterates the three 0x10-byte-stride adapter arrays rooted at DAT_006b3838/3844/3850, GlobalFree'ing each entry's name/data pointers and resetting counts to -1.
results.summary: Frees all GlobalAlloc'd network-adapter list entries across the three port/group arrays and resets their counts.

results.name: network_adapter_list_add_entry
results.evidence: growable_array_add_element reserves a slot in (&DAT_006b3838)[group*3]; GlobalAlloc's a copy of the wide name string and, if given, a data blob, storing an id and flag byte, and sets DAT_007192f8 when the flag is set.
results.summary: Adds a named entry (with optional data blob) to the current network-adapter/port list.

results.name: network_adapter_list_get_data
results.evidence: Bounds-checks an index against (&DAT_006b3834)[group*3] and returns the data pointer field (+4) from the matching 0x10-byte record.
results.summary: Returns the stored data pointer for the given index in the current network-adapter list.

results.name: network_adapter_list_get_id
results.evidence: Same bounds check as FUN_004a7c50 but returns the +8 field (the id/param_2 stored by FUN_004a7ba0), defaulting to -1.
results.summary: Returns the stored id value for the given index in the current network-adapter list.

results.name: network_adapter_list_find_first_available
results.evidence: When DAT_007192f8 (a priority-entry flag set by FUN_004a7ba0) is set, scans the 0x10-byte-stride records for the first with flag byte (+0xc) ==0, else returns 0.
results.summary: Finds the first non-priority-flagged entry in the current network-adapter list, or the first entry if none are flagged.

results.name: list_widget_scroll_offset_get
results.evidence: Recomputes and clamps the visible-window scroll offset (in_EAX+0x3e) against the item count from a tag lookup (DAT_0087bc14) and the widget's visible-row count (+0x12), used internally by FUN_004a7db0.
results.summary: Computes/clamps the current scroll offset for a scrollable list widget.

results.name: network_adapter_select_list_widget_refresh
results.evidence: Operates on the same (&DAT_006b3834)/(&DAT_006b3838) group arrays as the network-adapter-list helpers, walking the widget's item children and invoking a caller-supplied formatting callback (param_2) per visible row.
results.summary: Rebuilds a scrollable selection list widget's visible rows from the current network-adapter/group array, using a caller-supplied item-formatting callback.

results.name: profile_port_select_list_widget_build
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004a7db0 with the default callback, clears a paired widget's +0x58, then calls FUN_004a4e20 (profile-assignment refresh).
results.summary: Build/refresh callback for a port/profile selection list that also refreshes the linked profile-assignment widget.

results.name: network_adapter_get_name_and_flag
results.evidence: Bounds-checks index against (&DAT_006b3834)[DAT_00692c04*3], copies the adapter's name string (0x10-byte record field 0) into the destination buffer via _wcsncpy, and returns a flag byte from the separate DAT_00712dcc/DAT_00712dd0 array.
results.summary: Formats the display name for one network-adapter list entry and returns its associated configuration flag, for use as a list-widget item callback.

results.name: network_adapter_select_widget_build
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004a7db0 with FUN_004a83d0 as the item-formatting callback, then writes the selected entry's value from DAT_00712dcc into three paired widgets.
results.summary: Build/refresh callback for the network-adapter selection list, syncing the chosen adapter's configuration value into linked widgets.

results.name: game_variant_select_list_widget_build
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004a7db0 with the default callback, looks up the selected slot's data pointer, and forwards it to multiplayer_settings_select_list_update_item.
results.summary: Build/refresh callback for a game-variant selection list that also updates its linked description widget.

results.name: game_variant_select_list_widget_build_with_flag
results.evidence: Same FUN_004a7db0 + multiplayer_settings_select_list_update_item pairing as FUN_004a84d0, plus an extra enable/alpha toggle on an 11th sibling widget based on a bit in the selected entry's data (+0x94 & 1).
results.summary: Build/refresh callback for a game-variant selection list that also toggles an associated flag widget based on the variant's data.

results.name: player_profile_select_list_widget_build
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004a7db0, then either resets the same 8 detail-widget flags used by FUN_004a6100's null-profile branch when the selection is out of range, or calls FUN_004a6100 with the selected profile's data pointer.
results.summary: Build/refresh callback for the player-profile selection list, driving the profile-details widget refresh for the current selection.

results.name: network_group_get_name
results.evidence: Dispatches through jump table PTR_LAB_00692c08 indexed 0..3 by in_AX, falling back to the default string pointer PTR_DAT_0066a8a0 for out-of-range values.
results.summary: Returns the display-name string for one of four network group/tab types by index.
